headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, Trilegal act on The Pant Project ₹109 crore Series B fundraise
sum: Aanswr Fashion Private Limited, dba The Pant Project, has raised ₹109 crore from a Series B fundraise led by Mirae Asset Venture Opportunity Fund II, with participation from existing investors Sorin Investments, and marquee angels like…
detail: Aanswr Fashion Private Limited, dba The Pant Project, has raised ₹109 crore from a Series B fundraise led by Mirae Asset Venture Opportunity Fund II, with participation from existing investors Sorin Investments, and marquee angels like Hyperscale Ventures, MGA Ventures, B2V Ventures and B&K Securities. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised The Pant Project on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Navruz Vakil (Partner). Navruz Vakil Trilegal advised lead investor Mirae on this fundraise.
